releaseApproval.reviewer: User-authorized media preview navigation release; persistent formats unchanged
evidence: Image and video previews support previous/next buttons and left/right keyboard shortcuts in displayed order, including HEIC and trash views; other file types are skipped and boundaries do not wrap.
Switching cancels pending reads, releases old image object URLs and unmounts the old video session. Native media and editing controls retain their arrow keys.
Local validation passed: 590 frontend tests, TypeScript checks, production build and nine real Chromium preview ownership/navigation regressions.

Publication requires successful complete main-branch Linux CI including installation/upgrade tests and race checks for the exact tagged commit, followed by release archive checksum verification. Local macOS installation-script timeout results from the previous release remain recorded in ignored output logs.

scope: XDrive v2.0.10 adds bounded image/video preview navigation. SQLite schema 9, encryption, client protocol and backup formats are unchanged.

evolutionPolicy: Unknown payload versions and unknown fields remain fail-closed.
The listed optional fields and their absent-value meanings are part of the current schema contract.
Adding or redefining a payload field requires a new payload schema version; it must not silently expand an older strict reader.
A change that makes a stale client unsafe for mutations increments the client mutation protocol version in Go and TypeScript.
Key derivation or AAD meaning changes use their own crypto version; they do not reuse a payload schema number.
SQLite schema migration, backup container format, encrypted object envelope, and browser payload schema are independent version dimensions.
